news.headline: Nasdaq tries to bounce after its worst day since June; still on pace for a 2nd straight weekly loss
Meta fell ~7% after raising its 2026 capex floor to $135-145B, dragging chips and AI names
10-yr yield back under 5% (~4.99%) after its biggest one-day drop in 2+ years
Oil near a 5-month high on Middle East tension: Brent ~$112, WTI ~$102
Odds of a Fed hike at next week's meeting fall to ~5% (from 37% at end of September)
VIX up ~3% to 19.6; Dow lower, S&P roughly flat
AmEx -3% on revenue miss, plans ~5% job cuts
SpaceX reportedly eyeing ~80k US cell sites: Crown Castle +7%, AT&T/Verizon/T-Mobile lower

takeaway: Tech is trying to bounce after Thursday's AI capex selloff while yields ease under 5%. Next week is loaded: FOMC Wednesday 2 PM, then GDP and PCE Thursday 8:30.
